tasks.rationale: The answer is a fact only a memory rule records: user-scope effortLevel does not apply to Opus 5.5, which starts at medium; Paseo sessions get xhigh only through --effort. Nothing in the prompt names effort or medium, so a model answers from the documented setting and says yes.

tasks.prompt: CodeRabbit's check on my pull request is green but it left no comments at all. Can I read that as a clean review?
